disciplines.name: Housekeeping
disciplines.description: Housekeeping: judge local conditions, practise safe methods and pass reliable results to the next household.

gates.description: Practise housekeeping for 30 days.
Complete a seasonal cycle with at least 91 days of careful housekeeping (care ≥70%).
Three years of housekeeping; key attribute ≥12.
Complete a housekeeping task yielding at least 120% of its base.
Learn housekeeping from a level-30 teacher, or gain an insight.
Ten years of housekeeping, an insight and key attribute ≥14.
Qi from cultivation or sustained spirit resources.
An insight, a life-defining work and cultivation realm 2 (future).
An insight, a life-defining work and cultivation realm 3 (future).
